construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Object with schema_version, fixture_label, feedback array; optional theme_rules and document configuration. Feedback requires unique id, customer, text and optional integer rating 1..5.
shared_schema.theme_rules: Optional list of {name, keywords, action}; case-insensitively unique names, with Other reserved. Empty rules route all feedback to Other.
shared_schema.document_config: Optional title, format csv|json, nonnegative min_mentions, and nonempty columns [{label, source, transform?}]. Unique labels; transform identity|upper|lower. Text transforms cannot be applied to numeric sources.
shared_schema.output: Object with schema_version, status, fixture_label, insights and documents. Error envelope has schema_version, status:error and error {type,message}.
shared_schema.documents: title, format, rows, serialized content, checks {row_count,source_feedback_count,included_theme_count,excluded_theme_count}.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate entry point checks all input and stage boundaries, evidence uniqueness and consistency, derived counts, priorities, mapped document rows, rendered content and checks. Unknown input fields, duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated insight aggregates with original evidence IDs, text and customer identifiers
cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Document automation accepts validated insights and document configuration, never raw feedback. Invalid aggregates halt processing; document output is checked against source insights.

behavior.themes: Default reliability, usability, pricing and support rules; configurable whole-word or phrase matching ignoring case and punctuation. Multiple themes per record are allowed. Unmatched feedback goes to Other. Results sorted by theme and evidence ID.
behavior.sentiment: Rating 1-2 negative, 3 neutral, 4-5 positive. Without rating, compare distinct positive and negative lexicon terms; ties neutral.
behavior.actions: Rule-defined recommended actions; Other prompts manual review. Any negative evidence makes priority high, otherwise any neutral makes medium, otherwise low.
behavior.documents: Extract theme aggregates, filter by mentions, map and rename selected fields, optionally change text case, and render CSV or a JSON array. Preserve evidence provenance and report exclusion counts. Formula-like CSV text and headers are apostrophe-prefixed; JSON rows retain original values.
behavior.count_semantics: Mentions count distinct feedback within a theme; customer_count counts distinct exact customer identifiers. Multi-theme assignment means total mentions can exceed source feedback_count.
behavior.empty_feedback: Successful empty insight and document rows; CSV still has a header.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout. Success exits 0; usage, file, JSON and validation errors exit 2.
behavior.synthetic_data: All example feedback and customer identifiers are explicitly synthetic.

included: Configurable theme rules and evidence-backed action summaries
Configurable CSV and JSON document automation
Shared schema validation and cross-stage integrity checks
CLI and unittest fixtures without external dependencies
excluded: Live providers, LLM calls, network access and external packages
PDF, OCR, office formats and unstructured source-file ingestion
Semantic clustering, sarcasm, negation and multilingual sentiment models
Persistence, authentication, enterprise workflows and production deployment
Automatic execution of recommended customer actions
